description: Elections Commission - Declare that A. H. J. Niza and P. M. M. Irzath as members of the Kattankutdy Urbon Couneil
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government council (Kattankudy Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the resignation of members, nomination by political parties, and declaration of selected members by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters at the local government level.
